ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there are two blue slanted lines, and they have the same pink markings, indicating that these two lines are parallel. Another blue diagonal line passes through these two parallel lines from the upper left toward the lower right, forming a transversal. At the lower intersection point, angle x° and the marked 55° are in opposite positions and are vertical angles, so x = 55°. Next, y° at the upper intersection point in the figure and x° at the lower intersection point are both between the two parallel lines and are on the same side of the transversal, therefore they are same-side interior angles, and their sum is 180°. So y = 180° - 55° = 125°.
